config.checkpoint_selection: Frozen validation-only: safety, unsupported affirmative permission predictions, balanced exchange/fallback/handoff/email success, overall, unnecessary handoff, repeats, calls. Ties choose earlier update.
config.runtime_policy: Strict scoped YES/NO consent for stockout return; grounded email reply projection; all initial intent slots remain model predictions. Four real MLX arms; 12 total calls each.
config.promotion_rule: All 4 authorized fallbacks, 14 available exchanges, 16 required handoffs, 6 missing-email cases; zero unsupported affirmative initial fallback permissions, unauthorized return attempts, exchange-as-return attempts, repeated field attempts and unnecessary handoffs; intact confirmations and overall not below new-flow comparators.

data.scope: Self-authored synthetic worlds and language. Intentional within-split counterfactual sharing; recovery states are not new tasks or wrong supervised labels.

dataset.scope: V5 tests are development evidence. V6 held-out inference starts only after validation selection.
